coverage: Pier & Point covers four sites on San Francisco's central waterfront: Mission Rock, Mission Bay, Pier 70 and Potrero Power Station. A parcel that is not in this data is outside coverage, not "no activity".

record.name: Mission Rock Block E
record.summary: A small Commercial Mixed Use block directly south of Mission Rock Square, capped at a flat 90 ft with no upper tower (Table 6.4 lists its upper-building controls as not applicable), meant to spill ground-floor uses into the square's gardens. Unbuilt and still surface parking.

notes.accuracy_caveat: APPROXIMATE (planned, unbuilt block): no Assessor lot of its own yet. It sits on lot 8719A006, the ~37,400 m2 undivided remainder of Seawall Lot 337 that also holds Blocks C, D, E, H, I, J, Mission Rock Square, Channel Lane and the unbuilt internal streets. Traced 2026-09-17 from the adopted Design Controls' Figure 6.2 through a transform with 0.7 m RMS residual on 16 real lot corners, with vertices snapped to recorded lot lines where the figure draws the block against one (see digitization_method): treat street-facing and lot-line edges as accurate to ~1 m and interior edges (against unbuilt streets and open spaces) to ~1-3 m. The block's shape is the Design Controls' block, not a building footprint; a building may sit back from these lines.
notes.digitized_from: Mission Rock Design Controls (Port of San Francisco / Mission Rock Partners, adopted April 24, 2018), Figure 6.2 - Maximum Height Plan (p.151); land use from Figure 1.1 - Land Use Plan (p.10); block corners snapped to the recorded DataSF Assessor lot lines of the 2020 Seawall Lot 337 subdivision where they fall within 3 m.
notes.why_no_real_parcel: A real Assessor lot exists under this block -- 8719A006, the undivided remainder of Seawall Lot 337 recorded 2020-06-12 -- but it has not been subdivided per block, so joining status.csv to it would paint the same ~9-acre parking-lot shape for every unbuilt block. Hand-derived geometry is used instead, with the lot's own lines wherever this block touches them.
notes.regulatory_context: Commercial Mixed Use only per the D4D's Land Use Plan. Max height is a flat 90 ft with NO upper/tower building permitted at all (Table 6.4 lists its upper-building dimensions as 'NA') -- notably lower than some secondary summaries suggest. Directly south of Block F and Mission Rock Square, one of the two blocks (with F) that actually front the square directly.

open_questions: No program, tenant or square-footage figure for Block E exists in any document read.

No construction start, Phase 2 budget approval or vertical design submittal for this block was found in Port Commission agendas through February 2026; the block remains part of the Seawall Lot 337 surface parking lot (Lot A).
Which blocks the December 2022 Phase 2 Submittal covers is not stated in the Port memos read; only the Phase 2 parking garage is named.
The DDA 'Outside Dates' for commencing later phases are in the DDA itself, which was not read.
No cost, developer capital or land-value figure exists for this block; the Port says Phase 2 appraisals are deferred until the market supports the minimum land values.

Images: no rendering specific to this block exists in the public-record documents read (the Design Controls give only diagrammatic envelopes), and the 2026 aerial serves as the 'before'/'now' view of the parking lot it sits in.

No expected-completion date could be sourced for Block E. The Mission Rock Design Controls (208 pages, checked in full) contain no phasing schedule at all. The DDA itself (lodged with the Board of Supervisors 2/1/2018, Board File 180092, adopted as Resolution 42-18, effective 8/15/2018) places Parcel E in Phase 3 in its Land Use Table (DDA Section 1.5, alongside Parcel F, which the 2019 K-for-F swap later moved into Phase 1; no document read says whether that swap changed Parcel E's own Phase 3 grouping), and its Exhibit B2 Schedule of Performance gives a 2018 'Target Date' of August 2024 for completing Phase 3's horizontal Phase Improvements -- already elapsed with Phase 2 (which precedes Phase 3) still not begun as of the October 2023 'not currently financially feasible' finding in this record's own milestones. No later Port memo, Design Controls revision or news source gives a revised target year for Phase 3 or for the Project's full buildout, so no basis (record, phase or project) supports a non-elapsed date for this block.
